name: Foreman's Plight
summary: Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep asks you to find the Foreman's Crate and bring it back. Its return is what he seeks.

sections.title: A Missing Crate
sections.body: In Farholde Keep, Bertrand Ironbrow is looking for the Foreman's Crate. You are asked to locate it and bring it back to him.

faq.answer: Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep asks you to find the Foreman's Crate and return it to him.
You are looking for the Foreman's Crate.
Bring the Foreman's Crate back to Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep.
